## Problem

What engineering workflow is difficult or missing?

## Proposed change

Describe the feature.

## Engineering value

Explain how it improves learning, building, measurement, documentation, reliability, or analysis.

## Data impact

Would this require new tables, fields, relationships, Storage objects, or derived metrics?

## Verification

How should the feature be verified before being considered complete?

## Documentation

Which README, architecture, standards, changelog, or user-guide sections should change?
